sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent skills and reusable procedures; agent operations and context; developer experience and browser tooling; multimodal and specialized output. Languages in the listed set: JavaScript 5, Python 4, TypeScript 4, Shell 1, C++ 1, HTML 1.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The landscape is shifting from standalone AI applications toward the surrounding agent operating layer: skills, context control, memory, browser inspection, visual artifacts, and domain-specific workflows.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: This week points to an ecosystem-building phase for coding and personal agents. Reliable interfaces around agents—skills, context, verification, and outputs—are attracting more momentum than generic model wrappers.
